description:
Find the products carrying one or more barcodes (GTIN, EAN or UPC)
    at Aldi, Tesco, SuperValu, Dunnes Stores and Lidl in one call.

    Codes are accepted exactly as printed: leading zeros, spaces and hyphens
    are ignored. Needs a signed-in BasketWatch account.

    Args:
        codes: one barcode, or up to 100 separated by commas
            (e.g. "5000127014084" or "5000127014084,5000157024671").
        store: optionally restrict to one of "aldi", "tesco", "supervalu",
            "dunnes" or "lidl".
        include_copy: also return ingredients and per-100g nutrition where
            the retailer publishes them.

    Returns {"products": [...], "not_found": [...], "invalid": [...]}. Each
    product row carries store, matched_barcodes, name, brand, pack_size,
    price and its full barcodes list. One credit per barcode found, however
    many retailers stock it; codes with no match cost nothing.
name: lookup_barcode
title: Look up products by barcode
